2–4 hours (plus the time to gather a team and the gems)

An experiment by Magister Alverus went wrong and he was frozen in the Ivory Towers of Edron. {npc:Arkulius} sends you to the elemental sphere of your vocation to defeat an Overlord and bring back its elemental matter. Then a team with one character of each vocation summons and kills the {creature:Lord of the Elements}. Each vocation receives its own equipment and everyone gets the achievement **Lord of the Elements**.

One of Magister Alverus's experiments went wrong and now he is frozen in one of the Ivory Towers of Edron. Only with the power of several vocations together (each with one element) can this great alchemist be saved.
Arkulius, top floor of the southeast tower of the Ivory Towers
For the final mission: one character of **each vocation**, all level 80+ and with the first mission done.

You cannot have any soil elemental or Overlord item in your inventory when you ask for the mission (Glimmering Soil, Natural Soil, Energy Soil, Iced Soil, Spirited Soil or boss drops): Arkulius says they are fake and refuses.
one per player recommended for the final mission
all players receive one; Arkulius buys each one for 5,000 gp
Keep anything that is soil or an Overlord item in the depot **before** asking Arkulius for the mission.
If you leave your elemental sphere before you finish, you need another 20 gems to enter again.
Only the player who deals the **most damage** to the Overlord counts for the mission: do this part alone or make sure you are the one hitting the most.

Collect the 20 enchanted gems of your vocation and go to the **top floor of the southeast tower** of the Ivory Towers, in **Edron**. Get to Edron by boat (for example, in Thais say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Bluebear}). The seven Ivory Towers ({wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}) are in the **eastern** part of Edron: enter the southeast tower and go up to the top floor. {npc:Arkulius} is next to the frozen Alverus. Say {key:hi}, {key:Alverus}, {key:shrines}, {key:sphere}, {key:mission} and confirm with {key:yes}.
If your level is below 80 he refuses. If you have soils or Overlord items in your inventory, he says *"Where did you get that?? It must be fake."* and does not give you the mission.

Go down to the **lowest floor of the central tower** of the Ivory Towers, where the four elemental shrines are. To get there, go back to the ground floor and enter the central tower; go down to the end.
To the **north** of the room is the {item:Mysterious Machine}. Make sure it is **OFF**.
Use the **20 enchanted gems** on the machine, one by one. Each player does this individually (one character at a time). If you try to put in more than 20, *"Turn on the machine now!!"* appears.
With the 20 gems in, turn the machine **ON**. If you did everything right, you are teleported to the elemental realm of your vocation.
You can leave the realm whenever you want, but to enter again you need another 20 gems.
Kill the elementals in your realm until you have **8 soils** of your vocation.

Go to the part of the realm that **has no elementals** and where there is a circle made of **8 pillars** (the look changes from realm to realm). Place each soil on the floor **next to** each of the 8 marked spots (holes, ice cubes, mushrooms or lava holes).
The circle of 8 pillars where the Overlord is summoned
Lure **2 elementals** to the circle and kill both **outside** it. The corpses are used to summon the boss.
Quickly, use the 8 soils on the 8 marked spots and then **throw the corpse of an elemental** into the circle. The Overlord of your element appears.
From the moment you use the **first** soil you have **1 minute and 40 seconds** to kill the boss. Don't waste time using the rest.

Kill the Overlord to get the item of your vocation (see table above). If you kill it before time runs out, you can throw another corpse into the circle and summon another boss (there can only be one at a time).
Only the player who deals the **most damage** to the boss completes the mission. If it is not you, Arkulius rejects you at the next step.

With the boss's item, go to the realm exit and enter the teleport: it is the way out of the elemental sphere. Go back to {npc:Arkulius} and say {key:mission}. He tells you to gather a team with the other vocations and bring an {item:Obsidian Knife}.
Each player must bring their own {item:Obsidian Knife} and the item of their Overlord (without it they are not teleported).
Placing each player on their shrine

Go to the lowest floor of the central tower of the Ivory Towers. There are 4 {item:Strange Carving|Strange Carvings} on the floor (as in the {wiki:Desert Dungeon Quest}). Each player stands on the shrine of their vocation: **Fire – Sorcerer**, **Earth – Druid**, **Ice – Paladin**, **Energy – Knight**. Pull the lever.
Strategy for the Lord of the Elements
You appear in an **X**-shaped room. Follow the signs for your vocation (there are no monsters yet). At the end of your corridor, use your Overlord's item on the machine.
**Do not enter the teleport** at the end of the corridor.

Go back to the middle room and join the team. Each player stands on one of the 4 squares in the middle room that have levers next to them. Pull the levers **at the same time**: the {creature:Lord of the Elements} appears and the walls shut you in the middle room.
From here you have **10 minutes** before you are teleported out.

Kill the boss with {spell:Ice Strike}, {spell:Energy Strike}, {spell:Energy Wave} and {item:Shiver Arrow|Shiver Arrows}. Then use the {item:Obsidian Knife} on its {item:Overlord's Ashes|ashes}. All players receive the {item:Neutral Matter}.
After the boss dies you only have **10 seconds** to open the corpse before it closes; after that you can still use the knife.

Leave through the teleport (if the 10 minutes run out you are teleported out anyway), go up to the southeast tower again and say {key:mission} to {npc:Arkulius} to receive the reward for your vocation.
Dragon Robe (Sorcerer), Greenwood Coat (Druid), Windborn Colossus Armor (Knight), The Ironworker (Paladin) or Spirit Bind (Monk) + Lord of the Elements achievement
You can enter the Lord of the Elements room again with the team 10 minutes later.
Arkulius buys each {item:Neutral Matter} for 5,000 gp ({key:trade}).

The description of the final room in the spoiler mentions 4 shrines (Fire, Earth, Ice, Energy) and does not explain where the Monk goes; the requirements call for one character of each of the 5 vocations.
